title: Hebereke's Popoitto (Europe): pause check
summary: Use an SD sector recipe for the European pause-status workaround.
rationale: The European first-read program has the alternate CMP/EQ preimage used by the built-in patch. The Japanese branch in that callback does not match this image and is not migrated by this recipe.

writes.effect: Change the European CMP/EQ immediate at 0601D398 from 1 to 0x78.
writes.reason: Retain the upstream workaround for a PAUSE-status loop without a menu RAM write.
